mintAuthority.summary: wiTRY is Brix's yield-bearing staking wrapper over iTRY. The wiTRY wrapper owner and the underlying iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3-of-5 threshold, no modules, no guard) sharing the same 5 signers, confirming issuer-controlled mint authority.

sources.label: Brix iTRY product and wrapper disclosure

controls.label: wiTRY staking wrapper owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: owner() on wiTRY (0xe346c29b5b60ef870b9724c57ccfbbc631e47dee) returned 0x7ac3bb10225a4ef27134bcf54454d545a1738662. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2). getOwners() returned 5 signers. getThreshold() = 3. getModulesPaginated returned empty array. guard slot = 0x0 (no guard).

controls.label: iTRY underlying token owner (Brix Safe 3/5)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: iTRY token at 0xb492b4afd9658093694cf9452d5c272e8230f3b0; owner() = 0xbdb430adf64ff1c8201c10221ddb846fa62613b6. masterCopy() = 0x41675c099f32341bf84bfc5382af534df5c7461a (Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2). getOwners() returned same 5 signers as wiTRY owner, threshold = 3. These Safe contracts share the same signer set confirming unified Brix issuer control.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295016: wiTRY wrapper owner and iTRY token owner are both Gnosis Safe v1.3.0 L2 multisigs (3/5, same 5 signers) confirming issuer-controlled architecture. MegaETH OFT adapter (0x15b271d9012b5820fc42b1c495b4c1e206547de5) owner could not be confirmed, MegaETH public RPCs returned errors, but the Ethereum primary chain is fully verified. MegaETH is a bridged deployment; the Ethereum Safe controls the canonical supply. Accountable independently reconciles the iTRY and wiTRY liabilities to backing assets. The public proof-of-solvency page advertises a 15-minute interval but showed reserve data last updated 2026-06-24, so the observed evidence supports periodic, not continuous, reconciliation. No registry evidence established prudential reserve supervision over wiTRY issuance. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: common Brix Safe signers control direct mint and upgrades, while dated Accountable assets-and-liabilities snapshots support periodic attestation-only oversight.
